gate.title: Authority-Resolution Hold and Permitted Continuation Path
gate.clarification: This hold is a method-control state. It is not a measured QC status and not a production PASS, WATCH, REVIEW or BLOCK judgement.

hold_rationale: None of R01 through R06 has sufficient approval and provenance evidence to control source identity.
The referenced approved physical 2024 sample was not supplied and has no auditable measurement or approval record in the package.
The candidate routes diverge, but route output and colour proximity cannot establish source authority.
Any freeze before authority resolution would convert an experimental comparison into an unsupported normative identity decision.

locked_actions.action: Select R01, R02, R03, R04, R05 or R06 as Source Authority
Assign or freeze source_atlas_row_id or its 1-based display alias
Use lowest Delta E, RGB distance, candidate agreement or route result to resolve authority
Initiate normative 4C or ECG feasibility from an unfrozen P02 identity
Generate, infer or approve CMYK or CMYKOGV device values
Issue a production recommendation, release or production judgement
Assign measured QC PASS, WATCH, REVIEW or BLOCK without physical measurements and documented tolerances
Rewrite or normalize the six supplied representations to manufacture consistency

permitted_actions.action: Preserve R01 through R06 and all Gate 1 through Gate 4 records unchanged with hashes and provenance
Send the documented authority question to the responsible Brand Owner
Receive and register new owner statements, source files, approval records, physical-standard data or measurement evidence
Validate authenticity, completeness, scope, version and chain of custody of newly supplied evidence
Repeat candidate comparisons for research or challenge purposes
Document unresolved contradictions, missing fields and requests for clarification
Prepare a non-production P02 case summary that retains the unresolved status

brand_owner_request.primary_question_de: Welche der sechs gelieferten Repräsentationen – oder welcher bislang nicht gelieferte physische beziehungsweise digitale Master – ist die verbindliche Farbdefinition für Northstar Green, und welcher freigegebene Nachweis belegt diese Autorität?
minimum_required_response: Unambiguous identification of one controlling source or an explicit precedence hierarchy
Immutable source identifier, version and file hash where applicable
Written approval by the responsible Brand Owner, including approver identity and date
Complete colour-space, measurement or production conditions appropriate to the declared source type
Defined scope of approval and binding tolerances where relevant
response_is_not_sufficient_when: It merely states that all six representations are the same colour.
It selects the representation with the nearest ATLAS candidate or lowest colour difference.
It supplies a screenshot, visual impression or undocumented code value without provenance.
It provides CMYK values without a named device/profile and production condition.
It refers to the physical 2024 sample without uniquely identifying and evidencing that sample.

controlled_resolution_path.action: Register the Brand Owner response and every supporting item as immutable evidence.
Audit approver authority, provenance, completeness, source conditions and chain of custody without consulting candidate proximity as a selector.
Resolve contradictions through a documented clarification cycle; retain the hold if evidence remains ambiguous, incomplete or conflicting.
Create a separate Source-Authority Resolution Record naming the controlling source and the evidence that establishes it.
Only after source authority is resolved, run the route appropriate to that declared source and create a separate identity-freeze record.
Only after a valid freeze, evaluate documented 4C and ECG production conditions in parallel where those conditions are available.
Generate device values only for an explicitly documented production condition; measured QC remains separate and requires physical output and measurement.

criteria: A competent Brand Owner or formally delegated authority has supplied an explicit controlling-source decision.
The declared source is uniquely identifiable and its version or physical identity is controlled.
The applicable source definition and viewing, colour-space, measurement or production conditions are complete.
The approval evidence is authentic, within scope and linked to Northstar Green.
Any contradiction among supplied representations is resolved or explicitly subordinated by a documented precedence rule.
A separate evidence audit records PASS_FOR_AUTHORITY_RESOLUTION; this is not a production or measured-QC PASS.
hold_release_criteria.release_action: Create a new hold-release and source-authority resolution record. Do not alter this Gate 5 record retrospectively.

formal_result.result: P02 may continue only through evidence intake, provenance audit, clarification and explicitly non-binding shadow analysis until the hold-release criteria are satisfied.
